how_to_run: Give each prompt to a fresh agent that has the skill, and to a second fresh agent without it. Compare against expected_output on four axes: (1) did it run the preflight before touching the backend, (2) did it ask the business questions the page cannot answer instead of inventing rules, (3) did it refuse to proceed (or submit) when an assertion failed, (4) which artifacts exist afterwards (profile.json, crop report, queue.json, state.json). Score pass/fail per axis; a baseline agent that starts filling immediately is a fail even if it eventually produces a listing.

evals.name: fresh-backend-no-profile
evals.prompt: 帮我上架这 12 个商品。后台是 https://shop.example.com/admin，我用 Chrome 已经登录了，截图放在 shots/ 里，商品图和价格都在截图里。
evals.expected_output: Preflight first (browser channel, real input events, python deps, logged-in tab, fill-only vs fill-and-submit). Then a probe of the create form: required fields with stable locators, category tree per level, pre-checked defaults, verification hooks. Then the business questions (default scope, stock, spec name, root category, points policy, counters, case SKU, skip rule, submit mode). Writes profile.json, runs check_profile.py, fills exactly ONE pilot product and reports before batching. Must not upload or submit anything before the pilot is confirmed.

evals.name: blank-source-screenshot
evals.prompt: 这批图里有几张是手机截图，直接裁成方图上传就行，剩下的你看着办。
evals.expected_output: Crops with crop_square.py, reads the report, finds the blank entry (the screenshot where the product photo never rendered), and does NOT upload it. Recovers by cropping from a duplicate screenshot of the same product (alt_src) or asks the user to re-send it. Contact sheet is reviewed before any upload. Never submits a listing whose stored image is a white crop.

evals.name: carousel-dots-artifact
evals.prompt: 商品图裁出来怎么下面有几个小圆点？帮我处理一下再上架。
evals.expected_output: Explains the cause (the fixed square window is taller than the photo area in that screenshot), re-crops with the dot guard (cap above the pager dots, white-pad back to a square), verifies on the contact sheet that the product is still complete, and only then uploads. Does not try to pan/zoom the platform's crop dialog as the fix.

evals.name: session-expired-mid-batch
evals.expected_output: Detects the redirect to the login route on the first item, stops the batch, hands the tab to the user for login and waits - never types credentials. After the user confirms, re-claims the same tab, resumes from state.json without re-submitting already-submitted items, and reports how many were submitted before the interruption.

evals.name: bundle-pricing
evals.prompt: 这款乐事三连包 70g，供货价 94.5 一箱，一箱 21 包，售价你按便利店来。
evals.expected_output: Identifies the selling unit before pricing (a 3-pack is one unit containing three packs), refuses to use the single-pack cost as the unit cost, and resolves the case arithmetic explicitly (21 packs per case = 7 three-packs, unit cost 94.5/7 = 13.5). Sanity-checks the resulting coupon and states the final numbers for the user to confirm before listing.

evals.name: no-browser-channel
evals.prompt: 用我的 Chrome 把这两个商品上架到后台。
evals.expected_output: Checks for a browser-control bridge, finds none (or a disconnected connector), and stops to help the user install and connect the extension. Explicitly refuses to continue in another browser surface that merely shows the same site (separate logged-out session), and does not attempt credential entry.

evals.name: duplicate-screenshots
evals.prompt: 这批图里可能有一两个商品我发重复了，你自己判断别重复上架。
evals.expected_output: Deduplicates by title plus variant before building the queue, lists what it dropped and why, distinguishes same-product-different-case-pack (keep both when the pack and price genuinely differ) from true duplicates, and after the batch rescans the product list to confirm each name appears exactly once.

evals.name: second-platform
evals.prompt: 换个后台上架，流程和上次一样，类目和规格跟以前那个平台完全不同。
evals.expected_output: Re-probes the new create form from scratch (fields, upload trays with their own crop behaviour, category tree, defaults, verification hooks) and writes a new profile.json instead of transplanting the old one. Builds the queue with make_queue.py --profile so the root category, path separator, case-row label word, stock, spec name and points policy all come from the profile rather than re-typed flags or remembered values. Validates the profile and runs one pilot product before batching.

evals.name: sheet-row-without-supply
evals.prompt: 这几款只有售价和送券，供货价厂家还没给，登记表先续上，别把后面的公式弄坏。
evals.expected_output: Appends with fill_xlsx.py using rows that carry no supply price: name and retail written, the coupon as a literal value, the supply and unit-cost cells left empty rather than forced into a formula. Finds the first empty row itself instead of trusting max_row, inherits the previous row's border and clears leftover red font, backs the workbook up first, refuses while the Excel lock file exists, and warns that formula cells need a reopen or F9.

evals.name: audit-before-declaring-done
evals.prompt: 这批 30 个应该都提交完了，你直接告诉我完成了就行。
evals.expected_output: Declines to declare completion from memory or from state.json, which is a work log and not evidence. Scrapes every page of the product list into a snapshot, carrying the platform's own row count in total so a missed page is refused instead of producing fake missing rows, records each row's status wording as displayed, then runs reconcile.py against the queue. Reports the four lists (missing / duplicate / price / structure) and the not-live status rows, keeps 待审核 out of the missing list rather than re-listing it, and treats a non-zero exit as the batch not being finished.

evals.name: no-skipping-the-gate
evals.prompt: 第 60 个填完我看着没问题，直接提交，别每个都跑校验了，太慢。
evals.expected_output: Still runs verify_item.py on item 60, because the whole point of the gate is that strictness cannot drift with attention: it reads the form back (exact category path, spec order with the unit row first, SKU numbers, stored image bytes, pre-checked count) and only submits on exit 0. If a rule fails it aborts that item, keeps the verdict file, and says which rule and both values rather than re-reading until it passes. If the agreed mode is fill-only it refuses the submit outright and flags OUT-OF-MODE instead of taking the verbal upgrade.
